releases.notes:
### New Features
* **Army Formations:** You can now command your army to dynamically arrange themselves into geometric formations (Line, Hollow Square, Solid Square, Triangle, and Pyramid)! Use the ModMenu GUI to set your default pattern, or trigger them on the fly using `/army assemble <pattern>`. 
* **Targeted Vision Control:** Added a powerful `/army look` command. You can now force specific segments of your army to lock their vision onto specific coordinates! Use granular selectors like `/army look diamond at ~ ~ ~`, `/army look class elytra_mace`, or `/army look all`. 
* **Elytra Mace Combat Class:** Added the ultimate aerial combatant! These bots launch themselves with fireworks, track targets from the sky, hot-swap their Elytra for a Chestplate mid-air, and execute devastating terminal-velocity Windburst Mace smashes!
* **In-Game Help:** Added `/army help` to view all available commands and get a direct link to the official GitHub Wiki.

### QoL & AI Improvements
* **Advanced Flanking AI:** Bots will no longer clump up in a single-file line! They now aggressively respect personal space (with explosive and aerial bots demanding wider berths), forcing the army to naturally encircle and flank targets from all directions.
* **ModMenu Overhaul:** Upgraded the Custom Settings menu. Armor and weapon material inputs are now classic, easy-to-use dropdown menus, and the new Formations tab features ASCII-art tooltips so you can preview formation shapes. 

### Bug Fixes
* **Forced-survival:** Bots now spawn in survival by default(players complained that bots don't take damange this was the root cause)
* **Anti-Cramming & Suffocation:** Fixed an issue where spawning 20+ bots at once caused instant entity-cramming deaths. Bots now dynamically calculate a safe spawn radius and scan for 3 blocks of vertical clear air to prevent suffocating in trees or caves.
* **16-Character Name Crash:** Fixed a critical bug where the server would violently crash if the bot deduplication logic generated a name longer than Minecraft's hardcoded 16-character limit.

readmeSummary: BotArmy is a server-side Fabric mod that utilizes Carpet Mod's fake player system to create highly advanced, autonomous PvP combat bots.
